card.name: Break inside numbers before fractions or section digits
card.fires_on: The space or period inside a number just before a fraction or a second digit, as in "11 3/8 in." or "(5.8)". It appears in measurements and in label section cross-references.

modes.label: Space before a fraction
modes.description: The space between a whole number and its fraction in a size or duration.

modes.label: Period in section reference
modes.description: The period between section number and subsection number in a bracketed cross-reference to Warnings and Precautions.

modes.label: Space in feet and inches
modes.description: The space after a feet value and before the inches value in a height.
